en.t: I went around to the back of the house.

units.source_text: 那里辟有一个朴素的小庭园，菊花都枯萎了。

en.t: There was a simple little garden there, and all the chrysanthemums had withered.

units.source_text: 高处安装了一个水槽，是供夏季游泳归来的房客冲洗身上的沙子用的。

en.t: A water tank had been installed up high, for lodgers returning from summer swims to wash the sand from their bodies.
